caseNameFull: McDonnell v. United States and Truda v. Same
attorneys: Mr. Robert Ash for petitioners. Solicitor General Thacher, Assistant Attorney General Rugg, and Messrs. Whitney North Seymour, H. Brian Holland, and Erwin N. Griswold for the United States.

opinions.text: Petitions for writs of certiorari to the Court of Claims granted limited to the question of the validity of the waiver under § 278(e) of the Revenue Act of 1924.
